primary_input: Sealed Metric3D Native Confidence and depth outputs; existing cache only
execution: Local gamecam-vo Conda environment; CPU intake/statistics; no model rerun needed
admission_required: Matched pixelwise GT depth for the exact dataset/sequence/RGB IDs
Confirmed prediction/GT depth definition, unit conversion and scale provenance
Confirmed RGB-depth-confidence spatial transforms and GT-valid mask
Non-overlapping calibration/evaluation sequences with no test fitting
Sealed cached array identities and finite Confidence outputs
stop_rule: If GT, Confidence, units or GT-valid mask is unconfirmed, stop real-data calibration and error/NLL/coverage experiments. Report null, never substitute another dataset, camera poses or synthetic GT.
allowed_after_stop: Evidence reporting and a standalone source-derived, unfitted mathematical mapping with synthetic software unit tests only; no dataset experiment
confidence_semantics: Raw model score, not a probability
publication: Full original review ZIP and expanded files to existing Public repository; verify readback, then remove only this local delivered ZIP
